title: WheelSpeed-Front Placement Editor
note: One editor for both wheel speed harnesses (Dan X9, 2026-11-11). Routes drawn by Claude in the wireway corridors (Dan 2026-11-11); move devices only. Conditioners in the centre console just behind the ECU (Dan); sensors on each wheel knuckle under the strut tower (body manual under-body plan; 1993 service manual: one sensor on each wheel hub), +300 mm drop; front cables under the dash and the kick panels, out the LH / RH fender pass-throughs to the sensor plug at each wheel (Dan Y3 a); rear cables on the factory route (Dan Y2 a, 2026-11-11 11:54): across under the dash to the LH kick panel (factory floor-wire joint IF1, 1993 EWD p.43 / p.44), back along the LH floor to the RL knuckle; the RR cable leaves it under the front edge of the rear seat and crosses to the RH side, then back to the RR knuckle.
